title: An excluded combination is never served, and the contract records the exclusion with its references resolved.
why: behavioural spec 'exclude': no selected variant is inside an exclusion, and the contract records the policy with every reference resolved to its full id (variant semantics spec §3.5, §3.8; ADR 0080 decision 4). 'status' has two points and 'shippedAt' two, so the space is 4 and the selection exhaustive; excluding SHIPPED with no shipping date leaves 3. The SDK wrote 'status' and 'shippedAt', and what the contract records is what only the engine could resolve.
